title: OpenTouch
about: Egocentric in-the-wild recordings with a full-hand tactile glove on the right hand, Aria glasses video and Rokoko hand pose: 5.1 hours, 2,900 annotated clips in 14 environments.

hardware.d: 16×16 electrode grid, 169 taxels on fingers, thumb and palm (palmar side) · 30 Hz
RGB; 640×480 JPEG frames in the release · 30 fps · re-encoded here
21 hand landmarks + wrist and palm position · 30 Hz
Per clip, with contact onset, peak and post-contact frames

notes: Paper: arXiv 2512.16842. The code repository's package metadata says MIT; the release states no license for the data, which is shared from Google Drive. The sample videos are re-hosted here for preview with attribution. Raw readings are 3072 at rest and fall with pressure; the viewer shows 3072 − raw, uncalibrated.
